nodes.description: Public mapping(address=>uint) tracking token balances of holders in SEANETWORK.
Public nested mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) storing spending allowances.
Public total token supply of SEANETWORK.
Private owner address, set to msg.sender in constructor; gates privileged functions.
Public token name string.
Public token symbol string.
Public constant decimals = 18 used for supply scaling.
Constant internal Uniswap router address used in the constructor allowance setup.
Public payable transfer that forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
Public payable transferFrom with ensure(_from,_to) modifier; performs unchecked allowance and balance mutations.
Public payable approve that writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value.
Owner-only function executing a.delegatecall(b), letting owner run arbitrary code in this contract's context.
Owner-only batch transfer looping over _tos with unchecked multiplication and balance updates.
Modifier requiring _from or _to to be owner or _from to be the computed Uniswap pair address.
Internal pure function computing the deterministic Uniswap V2 pair address from factory and token addresses.
Payable constructor initializing name, symbol, totalSupply, owner, balances and a max allowance to the router.
msg.sender controls caller identity used for owner checks, approvals and origins of transfers.
Low-level a.delegatecall(b) in delegate(), executing untrusted callee code in this contract context.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value performed without SafeMath (pre-0.8 unchecked arithmetic).
balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value in transferFrom without overflow/underflow protection.
uint total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend without SafeMath, allowing multiplication overflow.
balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total and balanceOf[_to] += _value inside batchSend loop, unchecked arithmetic.
Recipient address parameter _to of transfer.
Amount parameter _value of transfer.
Source address parameter _from of transferFrom.
Amount parameter _value of transferFrom.
Spender address parameter _spender of approve.
Allowance amount parameter _value of approve.
Target contract address parameter a of delegate.
Calldata bytes parameter b passed to delegatecall in delegate.
Array of recipient addresses parameter _tos of batchSend.
Per-recipient amount parameter _value of batchSend.
Local variable total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend.
Loop local variable address _to = _tos[i] in batchSend.

edges.reason: msg.sender is compared against _from to decide whether allowance must be decremented in transferFrom.
msg.sender is used as the allowance owner key when approving in approve().
msg.sender must equal owner to pass the require in delegate().
msg.sender must equal owner to pass the require in batchSend().
State var owner is read in delegate() to authorize the caller.
State var owner is read in batchSend() to authorize the caller.
The ensure modifier reads owner to whitelist _from/_to.
delegate() executes the unsafe low-level delegatecall operation on the caller-supplied target.
Parameter b supplies the calldata executed by the unsafe delegatecall.
Parameter a supplies the target address of the unsafe delegatecall.
transferFrom reads and writes allowance[_from][msg.sender].
transferFrom performs unchecked allowance subtraction without SafeMath.
transferFrom reads and writes balanceOf for _from and _to.
transferFrom mutates balances with unchecked subtraction/addition.
transfer() delegates all work to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
batchSend reads and writes balanceOf for msg.sender and each _to.
batchSend computes total = _value * _tos.length without overflow protection.
batchSend subtracts total and adds _value to balances with unchecked arithmetic.
The ensure modifier gates entry into transferFrom.
ensure calls pairFor to derive the whitelisted Uniswap pair address.
Constructor sets owner = msg.sender.
Constructor uses msg.sender to assign owner and initial balance.
Constructor computes totalSupply = _supply * 10 ** decimals (unchecked multiplication).
Constructor initializes balanceOf[msg.sender] = totalSupply.
Constructor sets allowance[msg.sender][UNI] = uint(-1).
Constant UNI address is used as the allowance spender in the constructor.
Parameter _to flows into transfer.
Parameter _value flows into transfer.
Parameter _from is checked in the ensure modifier and used for allowance/balance keys.
Parameter _value drives unchecked allowance and balance arithmetic in transferFrom.
Parameter _spender flows into approve.
Parameter _value flows into approve.
Parameter a flows into delegate.
Parameter b flows into delegate.
Parameter _tos flows into batchSend and its loop.
Parameter _value feeds the unchecked multiplication and balance updates in batchSend.
Local total holds the unchecked product used to debit the sender in batchSend.
Loop local _to receives each _tos element credited in batchSend.

normalization_plan.reason: _to is only used to forward the transfer call and is scoped to transfer().
_value is only used to forward the transfer amount and is scoped to transfer().
_from is the primary account key consumed by transferFrom and its ensure modifier.
_value directly drives the unchecked allowance/balance mutations in transferFrom.
a is the untrusted target of the delegatecall operation.
b is the untrusted calldata executed by the delegatecall operation.
_tos bounds the loop and determines the total debit in batchSend.
_value is the operand of the unchecked multiplication in batchSend.
total is a temporary accumulation local confined to batchSend.
_to is a loop-scoped temporary recipient address inside batchSend.
